name: One Telecom
summary: Wholesale telco (One Telecom Pty Ltd, incl. ONEseniors/One Mobile; AsiaPAC group, ex-ispONE). Distinct from One.Tel (collapsed 2001). Acquired with AsiaPAC and iBOSS by Vocus Communications in May 2014, joint deal (ACN 076 483 657).

events.details: Wholesale telecommunications provider incl. ONEseniors/One Mobile brands (AsiaPAC group); founding year unknown. Not One.Tel.
Acquired with AsiaPAC Communications and iBOSS International by Vocus Communications 6-7 May 2014 (joint deal, see AsiaPAC).
